title: Travel Completed, APPR, Controllable, Flight Renumbered, Same Departure / Late Arrival (7h), Basic Aeroplan, Cancellation Code HDLG (ACS)
description:
The customer's original flight AC 435 YUL?YYZ was CANCELLED with code HDLG (ACS): a security check by AC's own ground handling, which is controllable. The customer was involuntarily moved to the renumbered flight AC 445 YUL?YYZ. AC 445 has the same scheduled departure (08:00) but arrives at 17:00, 7 hours after the original promised arrival of 10:00. A Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210) is linked. Checks six things: (1) involuntary reprotection and renumbering (AC 435 ? AC 445) are handled, (2) delay = actual arrival on AC 445 (17:00) minus original promise (10:00) = 7 hours, in the 6 to under 9 hour band (APPR Tier 2), (3) HDLG (ACS) is classed as controllable, (4) APPR Tier 2 applies (CAD 700 cash / CAD 840 AC Wallet), (5) the linked Basic Aeroplan profile triggers the dual offer, and (6) the customer picks Cash (CAD 700 by Interac).

Prerequisites:
PNR TC082: one passenger, Dominique Arsenault (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). Original flight: AC 435 YUL?YYZ, May 10, 2026, scheduled departure 08:00, scheduled arrival 10:00. AC 435 CANCELLED, cancellation code HDLG (ACS), security check by ACS ground handling, controllable. Fallback: FALSE (cancellation code available). INVOL reprotection onto renumbered flight AC 445 YUL?YYZ: scheduled departure 08:00 (same as original), actual arrival 17:00. Delay: 17:00 ? 10:00 = 7 hours. Status: Arrived (operated). AC only. Filed June 15, 2026 (more than 72 hours after arrival, 36 days, within 366 days). No duplicate. Not an employee, not an infant. CyberSource set to GREEN. Persona set to IDV PASS. RDS: no flags. Country of residence: Canada (CAD, Interac, email only).
